get.description: Cursor-paginated audit log for the workspace in `X-Relyxus-Workspace-Id`. No total count is returned.
get.summary: List audit events for the current workspace

post.description: Appends one hash-chained audit row for `X-Relyxus-Workspace-Id`. Requires `Idempotency-Key` so retries replay the same response.
post.summary: Record an audit event in the current workspace

get.description: Recomputes every hash link for the current workspace chain offline.
get.summary: Verify the workspace audit hash chain

get.description: Every change to a team, service, incident type or custom field, oldest first (MPS-14A.07): who, when, source, full state and exact difference. Versions are immutable. Cursor-paginated; no total.
404 `CONFIGURATION_VERSION_NOT_FOUND` for unknown objects or versions.

Incidents in the workspace named in `X-Relyxus-Workspace-Id`, newest first. Filter by one or more `lifecycle_state`, `severity` and `service_id` values (repeat the parameter). Cursor-paginated; no total is returned.

post.description: Creates an incident in the workspace named in `X-Relyxus-Workspace-Id`. By default it is declared (triage → investigating); `is_declared: false` keeps it in triage as a draft. The change is written to the workspace audit chain in the same transaction. Requires `Idempotency-Key`; a retry with the same key replays the first response. Requires the owner, admin, incident commander or responder role.
post.summary: Declare an incident or save a draft

get.description: One incident in the workspace named in `X-Relyxus-Workspace-Id`. Incidents in other workspaces return 404, the same as incidents that do not exist. The `ETag` can be sent as `If-Match` on transitions.

patch.description: Partial update of an open incident. Changing severity needs a `reason` (a human override, MPS-8.06). `impact_started_at` and `detected_at` can be corrected; neither may be in the future and impact cannot start after detection. Optional `If-Match` returns 412 if the incident changed since it was read. Recorded in the workspace audit chain and the timeline in the same transaction. Requires the owner, admin, incident commander or responder role.
patch.summary: Change an incident's title, severity or reported times

get.description: Grants of the incident, oldest first (at most 200), expired ones included.
get.summary: List who has been granted access

post.description: Grants one workspace member, team or workspace role access, with a reason and an optional expiry (MPS-20.30). Team and role grants count only for `restricted` incidents. Owners and incident commanders.

delete.description: Owners and incident commanders. Takes effect on the next request.

post.description: Records the first acknowledgement (who and when) for time-to-acknowledge (MPS-8A.20). Allowed from triage to monitoring; a second acknowledgement returns 409. On the timeline and in the audit chain. Requires `Idempotency-Key` and an incident-writing role.

get.description: Oldest first, cursor-paginated; no total. Visibility follows the incident.

post.description: Adds post-incident work to a resolved or closed incident (MPS-26.02). The owner, if given, must be a workspace member. `is_mandatory` defaults to true for SEV1/SEV2. Requires `Idempotency-Key` and an incident-writing role.

patch.description: Change title, owner, due time, mandatory flag or status. Cancelling needs a `reason`; done and cancelled are final. Send `owner_user_id` or `due_at` as null to clear them. Optional `If-Match` returns 412 when the follow-up changed since it was read.

get.description: Pending, accepted and cancelled handoffs, oldest first; cursor-paginated.

post.description: Proposes handing one incident role from its current holder to another workspace member (MPS-11.23). The handoff package is captured now. The role does not move until the incoming person accepts. One pending handoff per role. Allowed for the current holder, an incident commander or an owner. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.

The incoming person acknowledges the handoff (MPS-11.24); the role moves to them and the timeline records outgoing, incoming and time. Refused if the outgoing person no longer holds the role. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.
Cancels a pending handoff; the incoming person cancelling it declines it. Allowed for the requester, either person, an incident commander or an owner. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.
post.summary: Cancel or decline a role handoff

get.description: Links in both directions, oldest first; `direction` says which way each one reads. Cursor-paginated; no total.

post.description: Records that this incident is `duplicate_of`, `caused_by`, `related_to` or `recurrence_of` another incident in the same workspace (MPS-8A.31). Two incidents share at most one link of each type, in either direction. The link appears on both incidents' timelines. Not allowed once this incident is closed, cancelled or merged. Requires `Idempotency-Key` and an incident-writing role.

delete.description: Removes a link that this incident is either end of. Recorded on both incidents' timelines and in the audit chain. Requires an incident-writing role.

get.description: The review created when the incident was resolved (MPS-8A.11). 404 `INCIDENT_REVIEW_NOT_FOUND` before then. The `ETag` can be sent as `If-Match`.

patch.description: Edit the summary and lessons learned while the review is a draft or in review, or reassign its owner (review owner, incident commander or owner). Optional `If-Match` returns 412 when the review changed since it was read.

post.description: Reviews are created automatically on resolution. This creates one for a resolved or closed incident that has none (resolved before reviews existed). 409 if one exists. Requires `Idempotency-Key` and an incident-writing role.
post.summary: Start a review for an incident resolved earlier

get.description: Who must sign off before the review can be approved (MPS-13.13), and who has.

delete.description: By the review owner or a workspace owner, while draft or in review.

put.description: Adds a workspace member as a required reviewer while the review is a draft or in review. Idempotent. By the review owner or a workspace owner.

post.description: The caller, a required reviewer, signs off the review while it is in review. Recorded on the timeline. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.

Draft → In review (needs a summary, and lessons learned for SEV1/SEV2), In review → Draft (send back; clears sign-offs), In review → Approved (every required reviewer signed off; SEV1/SEV2 need at least one), Approved → Published (MPS-13.12). By the review owner or a workspace owner. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.
post.summary: Move a review through its states

get.description: Current holders of the incident commander, communications lead and scribe roles.

delete.description: Removes the role's holder. Idempotent: returns 204 even if nobody held it.

put.description: Sets the current holder of one incident role (MPS-11.04), replacing any previous holder. The assignee must be a member of this workspace. Only an incident commander or owner may assign. Recorded in the workspace audit chain.

get.description: At most 50 services, in the order they were added.
get.summary: List the services an incident affects

delete.description: 404 if the service is not listed. Incident-writing roles.

put.description: Names an active service of this workspace as affected (MPS-8A.08). Idempotent. Not allowed once the incident is closed, cancelled or merged. Incident-writing roles.

get.description: Oldest first, cursor-paginated; no total. Filter by one or more `status` values (repeat the parameter), e.g. the unfinished tasks to offer as follow-ups at resolution. Visibility follows the incident.

post.description: Adds a task to an open incident (MPS-11.14). The owner, if given, must be a member of this workspace. Requires `Idempotency-Key` and an incident-writing role.
post.summary: Create a live task on an incident

patch.description: Change title, priority, owner, due time or status. Cancelling needs a `reason`; done and cancelled tasks are final. Send `owner_user_id` or `due_at` as null to clear them. Optional `If-Match` returns 412 when the task changed since it was read.

post.description: At resolution, unfinished live tasks become follow-ups or are cancelled with a reason (MPS-11.21). This creates the follow-up (title, owner and due date copied) and cancels the task as moved. Only while the incident is resolved. Requires `Idempotency-Key` and an incident-writing role.
post.summary: Move an unfinished task to a follow-up

get.description: Every change to the incident, its roles and its tasks, and every note, oldest first. Events are written in the same transaction as the change and are never edited or removed. Cursor-paginated; no total. Visibility follows the incident.

post.description: Records a human note (`incident.note_added`) on the timeline and in the audit chain. Notes cannot be edited or removed; post a new note to correct one. Not allowed once the incident is closed, cancelled or merged. Requires `Idempotency-Key` and an incident-writing role.
post.summary: Add a note to an incident's timeline

post.description: Applies one lifecycle transition (ADR-0004) and records it in the workspace audit chain in the same transaction. Each move is limited to the roles MPS-8A names; cancelling and reopening need a `reason`; merging needs `merged_into_incident_id`; reopening is allowed only within the configured window after resolution. Closing is for the review owner or a workspace owner and needs an approved review, no unfinished tasks and, for SEV1/SEV2, complete mandatory follow-ups and a `root_cause`; a workspace owner may close with `closure_exception_reason` instead of the review, task and follow-up gates. Optional `If-Match` returns 412 if the incident changed since it was read. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.
post.summary: Move an incident through its lifecycle

put.description: Sets the visibility mode (MPS-8A.23): `workspace`, `restricted` (named people, teams or roles), `invite_only` or `confidential` (named people only). People without access get 404 for the incident and everything under it. The caller keeps access through a person grant. Owners and incident commanders; needs a `reason`.
put.summary: Change who can see an incident

post.summary: Install or replace the organisation licence

get.description: Uses `X-Relyxus-Workspace-Id` to resolve the organisation scope.
The verified identity behind the access token. Requires a Bearer token.
Every workspace the caller holds a role in, across organisations, with those roles. Backs the workspace picker. Cursor-paginated; no total is returned.
Reports whether an OPA bundle path is configured (evaluation stubbed).
Services of the open workspace, oldest first; cursor-paginated, no total. Filter by `owner_team_id` and one or more `tier`. Archived services are left out unless `include_archived=true`.

post.description: Creates a service in the workspace named in `X-Relyxus-Workspace-Id` (MPS-20.08). The `key` never changes. The owner team must belong to the workspace. Owners and admins only. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.
post.summary: Add a service to the catalogue

get.description: Services of other workspaces return 404, like unknown IDs.

patch.description: Partial update; the key never changes and `labels` replaces the whole set. `is_archived` archives or restores the service, keeping its values. Owners and admins only. Optional `If-Match` returns 412 when the service changed.

get.description: Teams of the open workspace, oldest first; cursor-paginated, no total.

post.description: Creates a team in the workspace named in `X-Relyxus-Workspace-Id` (MPS-14.01). The `key` is the team's stable identifier and never changes. Owners and admins only. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.

get.description: Teams of other workspaces return 404, like unknown IDs.

patch.description: The key never changes. Owners and admins only. Optional `If-Match` returns 412 when the team changed since it was read.
patch.summary: Rename a team or change its description

get.description: Oldest first; cursor-paginated, no total.

delete.description: Owners and admins only. 404 if the person is not a member.

put.description: Adds a workspace member to the team. Idempotent. Owners and admins only. Recorded in the workspace audit chain.

get.description: Workspace roles every member of the team inherits (Q-18).

delete.description: Workspace owners only. 404 if the team does not hold the role.

put.description: Every member of the team holds this role in the workspace, in addition to their own roles (Q-18). Applies only to people who are direct members of the workspace. Idempotent. Workspace owners only. Recorded in the audit chain.
put.summary: Grant a workspace role to a team

get.description: The workspace named in the `X-Relyxus-Workspace-Id` header, verified against the caller's role grants, with those roles. Unknown and forbidden workspaces both return 403.
Returns 200 while the process is running. Does not check dependencies.
Text exposition format for scraping (not JSON).
Returns 200 only when every required dependency is reachable; 503 otherwise.
